two_queue_timeline_ms_per_token.note: Every secondary-queue interval is hidden under primary-queue work; union-busy therefore equals the primary queue's inclusive work.

change_from_low_priority_shared_census_m.interpretation: Normal priority makes the shared branch materially faster, but that work was already hidden. The retained end-to-end gain comes from the smaller uncovered queue window, not from reducing device-busy union.

target_24_tok_s.interpretation: Eliminating all measured queue idle is insufficient by itself; reaching 24 tok/s also requires at least 0.491 ms/token of critical-path device-work contraction.

protocol.command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 HIPENGINE_LAGUNA_F16_DECODE=fixedk PYTHONPATH=. rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-format csv --output-directory /tmp/laguna-split-priority-census.Zi97yx --output-file current -- .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_long_context_profile.py --context-length 4096 --lengths 512 --chunk-size 2048 --decode-output-tokens 128 --repetitions 1 --warmup-rows 128 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-split-priority-census.Zi97yx/bench.json
protocol.segmentation: Sort by start timestamp and dispatch id; discard warmup128 and timed prefill512; report medians over the final 127 length-one embedding-through-published-control-argmax segments; merge overlapping kernel intervals across both queues for union-busy time.

interpretation.result: The split-priority policy reduces uncovered queue idle while leaving critical-path union-busy work effectively unchanged.
interpretation.primary_bottleneck: The remaining Vulkan wall gap is submission/dependency spacing. Source-F16 and selected MoE dominate arithmetic, while attention is only 1.118 ms/token.
interpretation.next_screen: Remove a real model launch at a repeated dependency boundary; ordinary HIP wrapper batching, per-layer graphs, direct AQL, and event-only rescheduling are already closed.
